text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess crosses the finish line!
She's
claimed first place!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(I can't catch my breath... I just want to
collapse in a heap right now... The sky
feels so far away...
My legs feel all
wobbly...)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(But... it really does feel amazing...
moving my
body with everything I've
got. In this moment
right now...)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (This... is how a princess runs!)

text_block_list.name: Girl with Braids
text_block_list.text:
You were really, really, really awesome
out there!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hehehe, indeed. I'm a princess, after all!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Victory is the only outcome fit for a
story's
heroine! And today's heroine is
none other than
me!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Now, feast your eyes on this,
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoosh!

text_block_list.name: Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Kawakami Princess just leaped up
onto the
fence!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before anyone can stop her, Kawakami
stands
atop the fence and pumps both
her fists
vigorously into the sky.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I ask for your continued support! Next,
I'm going
to dominate the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Wow, this is her turf now!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Haha, nice one, Princess! You're today's
lead star!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess continues to roar with

laughter as I hurry to get her down from
the fence
before she hurts herself.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I'm very sorry about that. The old me
came to the
surface for a moment...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock...

text_block_list.name: TV Station Staff Member
text_block_list.text: Excuse me. That was a great race out there today. I work on the show Meet the Racers!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, are you the one who made that
special
promo video?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Every door, every wall, and every
competitor
crumbles! The Princess has
entered the fray!"

text_block_list.name: TV Station Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's the one. And so, I wanted to
ask...

text_block_list.name: TV Station Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to do a collaboration
with us? I
want to feature you for the
Shuka Sho, too!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh my. It would be great if you could make a video inspired by Princess Fighter☆Stars this time!

text_block_list.name: TV Station Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
Wow, great! Thank you so much. I hope
to hear
some good news!
choice_data_list: We'll look into it, so if you coul...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah! Leave it to me! Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As we head outside, Kawakami Princess's
head is filled with thoughts of being on
TV. I remind her
once again not to do
anything dangerous.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After claiming first place, Kawakami
Princess has
been thrust into the leading
role.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As if the competition itself wasn't
exhausting enough, she's bound to feel
pressure from the attention, too. To help
her through it, I decide to buy her some
of her favorite sweets.

text_block_list.name: Chestnut-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Sniffle...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
(I've seen this racer's face before—she
was at the
press conference for the
Japanese Oaks.)

text_block_list.name: Chestnut-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I let you down despite your
support!

text_block_list.name: Chestnut-haired Umam...
text_block_list.text:
Please don't apologize. To me and
many, you are
our Queen of the Oaks!

text_block_list.name: Chestnut-haired Umam...
text_block_list.text:
I know that you can definitely,
absolutely win the
Shuka Sho. So...
please don't cry!

text_block_list.name: Chestnut-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
...Right! I swear I'll win the next race.
I'll
take the
leading role in the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There are many other Umamusume
betting
everything on the Tiara tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But on the prestigious stage that is the
Japanese Oaks, it was Kawakami
Princess who shone
brighter than the
rest.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, welcome back, Trainer! What's that
bag in
your hand?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, thank you! I was just thinking of
filling my
stomach with delicious sweets,
too!
choice_data_list: I brought some refreshments for you.
I brought some refreshments for you.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm going to do my best during
the concert
as well, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Of course!
choice_data_list: ...Yeah, go out there and shine as...
...Yeah. Go out there and shine wi...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take my seat in the crowd at the
concert where
only winners of the Tiara
tour can perform...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I watch on as Kawakami Princess sings Brilliant Phantasia.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our next goal will be the final stop in
the Tiara
tour—the Shuka Sho.
